newsitem.title: UK: BT shares extends climb ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: BT shares extends climb ahead of results.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc (BT) shares extended their gains on Wednesday after a BT joint venture won a German digital mobile telephone licence and analysts at NatWest Securities raised their profit forecasts.
Dealers said Tuesday's German news and NatWest upgrade were continuing to boost the shares ahead of the company's third-quarter results, due on Thursday.
The shares were up 10p at 440-1/2 by 1100 GMT. BT was London's most heavily traded stock, with volume of 8.3 million.
"They're still being lifted by yesterday's developments and people are taking a punt on them ahead of the results tomorrow," one market-maker said.
Other telecoms shares also firmed. Vodafone climbed 5-1/2p to 283 after setting a new record high of 284-1/2. Orange was up 2-1/2p at 203-1/2.
Cable and Wireless was 1/2p firmer at 479-1/2 as speculation continued about its plans for alliances with other firms.
